verdict.rationale: Rippling's first-party pages describe user-defined automation. Dynamic rules provision and revoke access as roles change (docs-3, docs-18), and custom workflows fire notifications on security threats and deliveries (docs-7, docs-11). Offboarding events automatically trigger device retrieval (docs-8), and the product pitch is "You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest" (docs-27), with "Automate workflows across systems" listed on pricing (docs-34). All of this is marketing-level copy, not in-depth documentation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the rule/workflow builder (available trigger types, conditions, action catalog), and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom event-triggered rules work as described.
